rows.concrete_observation: Actual registered Telekinesis SpellRay takes native ItemWand use/canCast/cast path. requiresPacket=false permits local client execution rather than dimension cast replay; ItemWand server still performs its cast and resource flow. Hit EntityItem directly changes motion; player-disarm branch requires settings.telekineticDisarmament and NOT active anchoring artefact, then nonempty mainhand. Server passes held stack to entityDropItem and immediately writes returned EntityItem velocity without null check; both-side code clears MAIN_HAND to EMPTY and returns true. Nonplayer Living cannot be disarmed here. Rejection returns false with onMiss false, no spell.resist message in this class. Anchoring activity consults config, cancellable/ALLOW artefact event, optional Baubles or prioritised mainhand/offhand/hotbar limit; this exact helper already in master.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: Disarming is an inventory mutation independent of HP, potion or knockback admission. A final immunity design must select the actual control producer and reject before item removal/drop. No-damage and absence of particle replay cannot establish immunity; rejected request here has no explicit reason receipt. Do not imitate the missing null-result check or use this player-only gate for Bosses.
